paragraphs.text:
You are under considerable stress, but there is no denying the 
evidence before you. It seems incredible, but Charlie may be 
possessed by an otherworldly entity.

To try and communicate with the entity, and perhaps learn the 
secrets of the valley, go to 445. To flee from this eerie vision, go 
to 437.
